metric_definitions.ci: paired percentile bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 0) of the per-row hybrid - bm25 difference; uninformative for n < 10
metric_definitions.hit@k (evidence coverage): 1 if at least one gold item is in the top k, else 0; mean over rows (the proposal names no coverage metric)
metric_definitions.precision@5: |gold in top 5| / 5 (fixed denominator 5, even when fewer than 5 items come back); with one gold item the maximum is 0.2

protocols.discoverable: msgfree, and also gold whose text the CI diff already shows (>= half of its lines are added by the diff) removed
protocols.msgfree: CI message item removed from corpus and gold; episodes with no other gold are left out
protocols.standard: all gold; includes the CI commit's own message, which the prompt already shows (not a discovery)

metric_definitions.recall@k: |gold in top k| / |gold| for the row, then the mean over rows; k = 1, 3, 5, 10 over a depth-50 ranking
metric_definitions.stale@5: |stale items in top 5| / 5, stale = stale_evidence_ids() heuristic, only for gold-UPDATE_TEST functions (else 0 stale items)
metric_definitions.stale_in_top5: 1 if any stale item is in the top 5
metric_definitions.unit: one row = one (episode, protocol, method); method 'group' has one row per oracle failure group with gold
